name: LINEAR – Divine Seer
source:
Set in a 'near-future' on a fictional world, LINEAR follows the story of Lanis Rosenberg, a young and inexperienced medic working in the Loennian military. Doubtful of her abilities to cope in the army, and lost with her direction in life, Lanis' world is suddenly turned upside-down the moment she meets Ash. An emotionless, biologically engineered soldier and her opposite in every way…

[From [url=https://renai.us/game/linear-01]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]

*Project has been discontinued. Story, art and format has been altered dramatically and re-released with Renpy as 'Ex Astris'.
translation:
故事设定在一个虚构世界的“近未来”，LINEAR讲述了拉尼斯·罗森伯格的故事。她是一名在洛尼亚军中服役的年轻且缺乏经验的军医。对自己能否适应军队生活心存疑虑，又对人生方向感到迷茫的拉尼斯，在遇见阿什的那一刻，世界被彻底颠覆了。阿什是一名毫无感情的生物工程士兵，在各方面都与她截然相反……

[引自[url=https://renai.us/game/linear-01]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]）

*该项目已停止开发。故事、美术和形式经过大幅改动后以Ren'Py引擎重新发布，更名为《Ex Astris》。
